messages:
jess: Quick docs heads-up — I opened a PR with updated on-prem installer steps and a small KMS/HSM example for air-gapped installs. Can someone sanity-check the commands and the linkfixes? PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/482

samir: taking a look now. main things to verify: systemd unit for pkcs11, env vars in installer, and linkcheck failures.

marco: heads up — HSM vendor expects `PKCS11_MODULE` path and the token label. Added a snippet that we should include.

marco: ```ini
[Service]
Environment=PKCS11_MODULE=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
Environment=PKCS11_TOKEN=redwood_token
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms.yaml
```

ops-liz: linkcheck failed on the migration guide — two relative links to the old 'networking.md' -> need to update to 'vpc-networking.md'

jess: ah thanks — I updated the links in the PR but didn't run the linkchecker locally. What command do you folks use?

samir: ./tools/linkcheck.sh docs/ --output report.html

samir: also added a tiny snippet for docker image import for airgap — `docker load -i redwood-ops-images.tar` then `sudo ./installer --airgap`

marco: another gotcha: mnemonic for the KMS proxy is that the installer replaces `kms_endpoint` with `unix:///var/run/kms.sock` when in airgap. We should mention that in the migration notes.

jess: good point. I'll add a short paragraph and an example config block.

ops-liz: test plan suggestion: 1) run installer on a VM with minimal network 2) verify `systemctl status redwood-kms-proxy` 3) curl the socket via `socat` to confirm it's listening 4) verify linkcheck passes.

samir: I'll take PR and run through the test plan later today. @jess can you add the 'how to test' checklist to the PR description? :+1:

jess: yep adding it now.

docs-bot: linkcheck report: 2 warnings, 0 failures — old networking links still show as redirects. See /tmp/linkcheck-report-1898765432.html

marco: quick note for HSM folks — add `User=redwood` to the systemd block to avoid permission issues.

jess: ok final checklist before merge: update installer example, include systemd snippet (with User), update migration paragraph about kms_endpoint rewrite, add test checklist, run linkcheck. Anything else?

ops-liz: add a small note about firewall/fwd rules: SNAT to the control-plane IP is required for the initial bootstrap in some setups.

samir: LGTM after I run tests. Will post results here.

jess: thanks everyone :heart:
